_doc: Denver Grand Prix 0.1.0 (ledger 0096): the race layout's own W1-6 arrow plate at the hairpin (W 14th Ave -> Santa Fe Dr, 134 deg), as Sand Creek's race layout has one at the S at 48th / Colorado: race furniture behind the race layout's sealing K-rail, shipped in that layout's closure kn5 alone (tools/place_signs.py per_layout; a whole-lap race closure carries its layout's plates, tools/split_exports_blend.py). Every other corner the W1-6 rule would sign is skipped with its reason: no rule-placed sign stands on Denver's streets (the survey's inventory places the real ones, 0.1.1). Defaults are Sand Creek's (Lake Murray's place_signs defaults) but pad_decks (no pads).

DGP-HAIRPIN.where: W 14th Ave -> N Santa Fe Dr (the hairpin, T8)
DGP-HAIRPIN.note: the race layout's plate, behind its sealing K-rail; the street layout has none
